metadata.description: Dev-pipeline skill corpus for Claude Code. Prose skills (SKILL.md) + generated state machines (skill.yaml). Companion to lucianfialho/atomic-gates.

plugins.name: claude-dev-pipeline
plugins.description: A corpus of dev-workflow skills (solve-issue, review-pr, validate-issue, check-security, suggest-tests) shipped as SKILL.md prose + skill.yaml state machines generated via the atomic-gates converter. Pairs with atomic-gates >= 0.3.0 for schema-validated execution, audit trail, and blocking gates on commit/PR.
